name: motif_count
author: 37c243f2
description: Counts small network motifs in a graph: triangles in undirected graphs and feed-forward loops in directed graphs. Use it to measure local structural patterns. Returns the total motif count, motif type, and up to top_k example motifs without requiring external graph libraries.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Maximum number of motif examples to return.
